Hello, Azukinsama. I sent in a request a while ago, and have cherished it a lot. I would like to send in a new request if possible.

The setting is 1950s-1980s America. 

(1) https://imgur.com/a/u4RG9B5
(2) https://imgur.com/a/eINEmjX 

They are coworkers at a detective firm. Parker is Jin's work superior. They are acquainted to each other because Jin wants to interview Parker about his past. Meanwhile, they hang together often. Jin will come to Parker's desk during work to talk to him, and will pick up his tie. They synchronize smoke breaks. Jin treats Parker to dinner. Parker drives Jin to different places. Jin comforts Parker. They argue often, over what song to play on the radio, to Parker criticizing Jin being unable to read the room. They're not too close, yet in an emergency, they'd hurry to the other. In a sense, Parker became Jin's girlfriend unintentionally. 

If you could draw them together to your own liking, I would be very happy. Thank you for your consideration.
